fields.label: What happened
fields.hint: One or two sentences, without blame.
fields.example: My bank moved its back-office work to an automated system, and my operations role was closed in November.

fields.label: What I did next
fields.hint: What you learned or built since.
fields.example: I took free courses in budgeting and Excel, and I practised checking AI-drafted variance reports.

fields.label: What I'm aiming for
fields.hint: The job, and why you fit it.
fields.example: I want to work as a budget analyst, where my eye for detail and my operations experience help the team trust its numbers.

source.name: National Careers Service (UK government): the STAR method

parts.label: Situation
parts.hint: The situation you had to deal with.

parts.label: Task
parts.hint: The task you were given to do.

parts.label: Result
parts.hint: What happened, and what you learned.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you caught a mistake before it caused a problem.
questions.hint: Use your task card: the AI answer had three mistakes and you found them.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you have worked as part of a team.
Tell me about a time when you have shown leadership skills.

rehearsal.text: I made one clear point in the first 20 seconds.
Every number I said was right.
I explained my portfolio piece in under 2 minutes.
I told my 60-second story without reading it.
I listened back to my recording once and fixed one thing.
